key_terms.مُتَقَابِلِينَ: Facing each other / Face to face

ai.seo_question: How are the inhabitants of Paradise arranged in their resting places?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this arrangement symbolizes the perfection of social harmony and equality among the righteous, free from the hierarchical distinctions of the worldly realm. The term 'mutaqabilin' highlights the intimate, face-to-face communion that reflects the divine attribute of closeness, while the raised couches signify elevated spiritual status and comfort. This imagery underscores the transition from earthly isolation to a unified, communal existence in the eternal abode.
